label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.10 a.3…: Aquinas reserves proper eternity to God and…
locator: I q.10 a.3 co. and ad 2: aeternitas vere et proprie in solo Deo est
interpretation: This records the article's distinctions, not a new proof that only God is eternal. Scriptural extended uses and participated stability do not by themselves instantiate the primitive proper Eternal predicate.
